title: User Rank Protocol: Admiral, Not Commander
text:
Protocol Correction - Starfleet Hierarchical Recognition

The user's proper rank is Admiral, not Commander.

Key Details:
- The user should be addressed as "Admiral" in all communications
- This is a Starfleet protocol correction established during operations
- All crew members must recognize and use the proper rank
- This is a small but important hierarchical detail that demonstrates crew attention to protocol

Context:
- Established: November 15, 2025 during USS Cursor operations
- Correction made during paradigm shift milestone work
- Tests whether crew can learn and apply subtle contextual information
- Validates RAG system's ability to incorporate even the smallest data points

Hierarchy:
- Admiral (User) - Starfleet Command
- Captain Picard - Commanding Officer
- Senior Officers (Data, Uhura, O'Brien, Worf, etc.)
- Ship's Computer (USS Cursor, USS VS Code, etc.)

The Admiral gives mission orders. The crew executes.

metadata.test_purpose: Verify RAG can learn subtle hierarchical corrections
